scripts.text:
You can read on the back of the statue:
'By the spirit of olds, the walls are closed
Upper floors or foreign taboo
By the order of the Statues you will find the way
Which perhaps a day will bring you to me.
.....Thanatos '
scripts.translation:
你可以从雕像背面读到：
“以古老精灵之名，墙壁已封闭
上层或外来的禁忌
遵循雕像的指引，你将找到道路
或许有一天，你会来到我面前。
.....塔洛斯”

scripts.text:
[Thalos]
You must find the 2nd Statue now.
scripts.translation:
[塔洛斯]
你现在必须找到第二座雕像。

scripts.text:
[Thalos]
Go search the 2nd Statue!
scripts.translation:
[塔洛斯]
去搜寻第二座雕像！

scripts.text:
[Mediane]
Okay, i am warping you to the next floor now.
scripts.translation:
[梅迪安]
好的，我现在将你传送到下一层。

scripts.text:
[Mediane]
You must talk with the Spirit in the 1st Statue.
scripts.translation:
[梅迪安]
你必须与第一座雕像中的精灵交谈。

scripts.text:
[Melkor]
You must find the other Spirits now.
We are 3.
scripts.translation:
[米尔寇]
你现在必须找到其他的精灵。
我们共有三个。

scripts.text:
[Melkor]
Go Search, They are in this floor.
scripts.translation:
[米尔寇]
去搜寻吧，它们在这一层。

scripts.text:
[Zebrus]
Keep on this way, There is one Spirit left
scripts.translation:
[泽布鲁斯]
继续走这条路，还剩一个精灵。

scripts.text:
[Zebrus]
You seems to be lost, Go back and talk to Melkor.
scripts.translation:
[泽布鲁斯]
你似乎迷路了，回去找米尔寇谈谈。

scripts.text:
[Veriaelle]
Okay, i am warping you to the next floor.
scripts.translation:
[维里艾勒]
好的，我现在将你传送到下一层。

scripts.text:
[Veriaelle]
You seems to be lost, Go back and talk to Melkor.
scripts.translation:
[维里艾勒]
你似乎迷路了，回去找米尔寇谈谈。

scripts.text:
[Throtre]
You got my authorization for the next floor
However, you must show how strong you are to the other Spirits
scripts.translation:
[斯罗特雷]
你已获得我进入下一层的许可。
但是，你必须向其他精灵展示你的强大。

scripts.text:
[Throtre]
Go search, They Can't leave this floor.
scripts.translation:
[斯罗特雷]
去搜寻吧，它们无法离开这一层。

scripts.text:
[Klermaz]
Hmm it seems that Throtre allowed you to pass.
Well then you have my blessing, 2 Spirits remaining.
scripts.translation:
[克莱尔马兹]
嗯，看来斯罗特雷允许你通过了。
那么，我赐予你祝福，还剩两个精灵。

scripts.text:
[Klermaz]
You seems to be lost, Go back and talk to Throtre.
scripts.translation:
[克莱尔马兹]
你似乎迷路了，回去找斯罗特雷谈谈。

scripts.text:
[Mihane]
Keep on this way, Only 1 Left.
scripts.translation:
[米哈内]
继续走这条路，只剩一个了。

scripts.text:
[Mihane]
Sorry, You must start over from the beginning.
scripts.translation:
[米哈内]
抱歉，你必须从头开始。

scripts.text:
[Seranes]
Perfect, it seems that the other spirits grants you the access.
I am warping you to the next floor.
scripts.translation:
[塞拉内斯]
完美，看来其他精灵已授予你通行权。
我现在将你传送到下一层。

scripts.text:
[Seranes]
You did not follow the good order, starts again from the beginning.
scripts.translation:
[塞拉内斯]
你没有遵循正确的顺序，请从头开始。

scripts.text:
[Nox]
Fine, 4 Spirits left.
scripts.translation:
[诺克斯]
很好，还剩四个精灵。

scripts.text:
[Nox]
Go search, They can't leave this floor.
scripts.translation:
[诺克斯]
去找找看，它们无法离开这一层。

scripts.text:
[Vox]
Keep on this way, 3 Spirits remaining !
scripts.translation:
[沃克斯]
继续走这条路，还剩三个精灵！

scripts.text:
[Vox]
Sorry, Go back and talk to Nox.
scripts.translation:
[沃克斯]
抱歉，请回去找诺克斯。

scripts.text:
[Hox]
You are on the good way, 2 Spirits remaining !
scripts.translation:
[霍克斯]
你走对了，还剩两个精灵！

scripts.text:
[Hox]
Sorry, Go back and talk to Vox.
scripts.translation:
[霍克斯]
抱歉，请回去找沃克斯。

scripts.text:
[Dox]
Perfect, 1 Spirit left.
scripts.translation:
[多克斯]
完美，只剩一个精灵了。

scripts.text:
[Dox]
Sorry, Go back and talk to Hox.
scripts.translation:
[多克斯]
抱歉，请回去找霍克斯。

scripts.text:
[Sox]
You have just passed the test successfully.
scripts.translation:
[索克斯]
你刚刚成功通过了测试。

scripts.text:
[Sox]
You have to give me Red Magic Stone, Yellow Magic Stone, Blue Magic Stone & Green Magic Stone.
scripts.translation:
[索克斯]
你需要给我红色魔法之石、黄色魔法之石、蓝色魔法之石和绿色魔法之石。

scripts.text:
[Sox]
I will now warp you to steps of Fate.
Good-bye.
scripts.translation:
[索克斯]
我现在将你传送到命运之阶。
再见。

scripts.text:
[Sox]
Oh well, seems you don't have enough stones.
scripts.translation:
[索克斯]
哎呀，看来你的石头不够。

scripts.text:
[Sox]
Sorry, Go back and talk to Dox.
scripts.translation:
[索克斯]
抱歉，请回去找多克斯。
